約書亞樂團
詞曲：WALKER BEACH／中譯詞：周巽光

lines.a: 若有人渴慕真理 需要盼望和能力
lines.b: Everyone who longs for truth, needing hope and strength renewed
Come and meet the Savior of the world

lines.a: 若有人飢渴慕義 尋找真正的生命
lines.b: Everyone who longs inside, desperate for the words of life
Come and meet the Savior of your soul

lines.a: 若有人在基督裡 死裡復活得生命
lines.b: Everyone who lives in Christ, died to self and raised to life
Come and praise the Savior of the world

lines.a: 若有人忍耐到底 憑信勝過一切恐懼
lines.b: Everyone who perseveres, faith will overcome all fears
Come and praise the Savior of your soul

lines.a: 神與我同行 祂愛降臨 掌管全地
lines.b: God is with us now, His love rains down His love reigns now

lines.a: 恩典和能力 祂愛降臨 掌管全地
lines.b: Saved by grace and power, His love reigns down His love reigns now

lines.a: 再沒有事能拆散我們 神與我同行
lines.b: Nothing can ever separate us, God is with us now

lines.a: 再沒有事能奪走應許 神與我同行
lines.b: Nothing can take His promise from us, God is with us now

lines.a: 再沒有事能取代耶穌 神與我同行
lines.b: Nothing can take the place of Jesus, God is with us now

lines.a: 不懼怕 不羞愧 得自由 與祂同行
lines.b: No more shame, no more fear, we are free 'cause God is here
